sources.scope: Existing managed page/content/font serialization reused without a new conformance claim.

decisions: Closed original merge syntax is SDK-owned, not a claim to execute all Word field/expression semantics.
Missing/empty/preserved-scalar policy is explicit; unsupported structural identities reject rather than inventing semantic rebinding.
Same root budgets and actual optional pinned Word provider apply; DOCX text uses XML escaping and forbidden-character rejection.
